# Application Auto Scaling execution and advanced policies

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend records-only configuration to a truthful capacity and metric evaluation contract.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Real capacity changes and resource integration
- [ ] CloudWatch alarm creation and metric evaluation
- [ ] Scaling activities
- [ ] Predictive scaling, forecasts and metric math
- [ ] CloudFormation nested scheduled actions and wider schedule syntax

## Integration decisions

Scalable targets, simple policies, scheduled-action metadata and target tags are implemented records only; no scaling execution is claimed.
